description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Solutions Consultant - Senior Principal, NA ENT

Why We Have This Role

Our pre-sales team helps some of the largest organizations in the world find and close experience gaps with the Qualtrics XM Data & AI Platform, which combines experience management (XM) data with artificial intelligence (AI) to predict what comes next and act on it.

As a Senior Principal Solution Consultant in North America Enterprise (NA ENT), you will partner with our Sales Teams on our largest and most strategic opportunities to win both the technical decision and the business case. You bring the product depth to show what the platform can do and the strategic perspective to help executives decide what to do with it. While most of your efforts will be focused in the pre-sales environment, some of the additional cross-functional initiatives may include input in product direction, content generation, contributing to analyst reports/relationships and attending marketing events.

You will report to a Solution Consulting Manager in North America Enterprise.

How You’ll Find Success

  •     Earning trust with Account Executives and Sales leaders as their go-to partner on deal strategy and execution.
  •     Becoming a trusted advisor and strategic partner to customer executives, helping them build their XM vision and a roadmap toward the art of the possible.
  •     Building and showcasing world-class product demonstrations to highlight the value of Qualtrics products in unique, compelling and creative ways.
  •     Winning the technical decision and the business case on complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
  •     Contributing to team outcomes, including win rate, pipeline, net new annual recurring revenue (ARR), customer satisfaction and strategy for key accounts.
  •     Raising the bar for the team by sharing what works and helping your peers grow.

How You’ll Grow

  •     Learning the full XM platform, including customer experience, employee experience and market research, and the AI capabilities that connect them.
  •     Deepen your expertise in AI and data and shape how customers apply them to business outcomes.
  •     Build influence with Product and Marketing by bringing field insight into product direction and go-to-market strategy.
  •     Grow as a leader through mentoring, deal coaching and cross-functional initiatives, with a career action plan built alongside your manager.
  •     As we build an AI-first company and change the market for Experience Management, you will be at the cutting edge of this transformation in enterprise software.

Things You’ll Do

  •     Partner with account executives on discovery, deal strategy and account planning for key opportunities.
  •     Lead discovery that uncovers business challenges and ties them to measurable outcomes.
  •     Design, build and deliver tailored demonstrations, prototypes and proofs of concept.
  •     Build business cases and value stories that connect XM and AI to revenue, cost and risk.
  •     Lead executive briefings and workshops that help customers shape their XM vision and roadmap.
  •     Answer technical questions on architecture, integrations, APIs, security and data.
  •     Position Qualtrics against competitors on both product strengths and business value.
  •     Mentor peers through deal reviews, demonstration feedback and shared asset development.
  •     Partner with Product Management, Marketing and Engineering on new and existing products by sharing customer and field feedback, and contribute to content, events and enablement.

Required Qualifications

  •     7 or more years in pre-sales, consulting or another go-to-market customer-facing technical or strategic role at a business-to-business (B2B) software as a service (SaaS) company, or as a practitioner leading large-scale customer, employee or research programs.
  •     Demonstrated ability to influence complex sales cycles both strategically and technically with C-level and vice president buyers.
  •     Strong technical aptitude and the drive to configure, build and deliver software demonstrations tailored to a customer’s needs.
  •     Experience building a business case or value story that ties a solution to measurable outcomes.
  •     Working understanding of AI and data-driven solutions.
  •     Experience coaching or mentoring others, formally or informally.
  •     Excellent written and verbal communication, including presenting to executives.
  •     Undergraduate degree.
  •     Legally authorized to work in the United States.
  •     Travel required (up to 25%).

Preferred Qualifications

  •     Experience in pre-sales (solution consulting, solutions engineering or solution strategy).
  •     Hands-on experience configuring, building or demonstrating tailored software solutions
  •     Experience with Customer or Employee Experience software or programs.
  •     Hands-on experience with AI tools in a customer-facing setting, using them to improve how you sell and go to market.
  •     Knowledge of survey design, change management, or quantitative and qualitative data analysis.
  •     Experience with manufacturing, consumer goods or business services customers.

What You Should Know About This Team

  • We play a critical role in the commercial engine, driving innovation and market penetration through direct work with customer decision makers and scaling our expertise across the field.
  • Our team values initiative and independence. Everyone is encouraged to think ahead, anticipate potential issues and solve them proactively.
  • We are known for our collaborative spirit, a strong desire to learn and, most importantly, a commitment to our customers’ success. We help Sales and Qualtrics hit their targets by building customer confidence and demonstrating the value of our technology. We are comfortable in a fast-changing environment, and creativity is often our best tool.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

  • Pension plan match
  • We offer private dental and health insurance
  • Wellness reimbursement - up to the value of $300 per quarter can be reimbursed for a variety of wellness activities

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: While this role is exempt from working in office, our hybrid work model remains elegantly simple for the rest of the company: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #remote

Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
 
​​​​​​​Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws:Family & Medical Leave Act, Equal Opportunity Employment, Employee Polygraph Protection Act
 
Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Qualtrics will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know.

For full-time positions, this pay range is for base per year; however, base pay offered within this range may vary depending on location, job-related knowledge, education, skills, and experience. A sign-on bonus and restricted stock units may be included in an employment offer.
